import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

BASE = ROOT / "outputs/integration-runs"
AUDIT = ROOT / "docs/validation-artifacts/integration-publication-audit"
BROWSER = ROOT / "docs/validation-artifacts/integration-final-browser"
AUDIT_NAMES = [
    "root-report-direct-dependencies.json",
    "publication-required-paths.json",
    "publication-content-inspection.json",
    "publication-direct-audit-receipt.json",
    "publication-evidence-audit-receipt.json",
    "publication-content-inspection-receipt.json",
    "publication-direct-audit.stdout.txt",
    "publication-direct-audit.stderr.txt",
    "publication-evidence-audit.stdout.txt",
    "publication-evidence-audit.stderr.txt",
    "publication-content-inspection.stdout.txt",
    "publication-content-inspection.stderr.txt",
    "run_publication_audit.py",
    "audit_direct_dependencies.py",
    "publication_evidence_audit.py",
    "publication_content_inspect.py",
]
manifest = json.loads((BASE / "publication-required-paths.json").read_text())
assert not manifest["missing"] and not manifest["ignored"]
browser_report = json.loads((BASE / "browser-final/report.json").read_text())
assert len(browser_report["records"]) == 564 and not browser_report["page_errors"]
checks = json.loads((ROOT / "docs/validation-artifacts/integration-final-local-checks.json").read_text())
assert checks["status"] == "passed"
AUDIT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
BROWSER.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
copies = []
for name in AUDIT_NAMES:
    source = BASE / name
    target = AUDIT / (name + ".txt" if name.endswith(".py") else name)
    shutil.copyfile(source, target)
    copies.append(
        {
            "original_runtime_path": source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "published_snapshot": target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        }
    )
for source in sorted((BASE / "browser-final").iterdir()):
    if source.suffix in {".png", ".json"}:
        shutil.copyfile(source, BROWSER / source.name)
for name, expected in browser_report["screenshots"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((BROWSER / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
(AUDIT / "runtime-snapshot-map.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "scope": "Byte-for-byte copies of the actual ignored runtime audit sources, outputs and command receipts. Copying does not rerun them or expand their declared replay coverage.",
            "files": copies,
        },
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    )
    + "\n"
)
modified = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--name-only", "-z"]).decode().split("\0")
selected = set(filter(None, modified)) | set(manifest["untracked_required_paths"])
for folder in (AUDIT, BROWSER):
    selected.update(path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for path in folder.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
assert not any(Path(name).suffix in {".pt", ".pth", ".ckpt", ".safetensors"} for name in selected)
pathspec = BASE / "final-publication-pathspec.nul"
pathspec.write_bytes(b"\0".join(name.encode() for name in sorted(selected)) + b"\0")
subprocess.run(["git", "add", "--pathspec-from-file=" + str(pathspec), "--pathspec-file-nul"], check=True)
tracked = set(subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "-z"]).decode().split("\0"))
assert set(manifest["required_paths"]) <= tracked
changed = set(
    filter(None, subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z"]).decode().split("\0"))
)
assert not any(name.startswith("assets/training/") or name == ".gitattributes" for name in changed)
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--cached", "--check"], check=True)
result = {
    "checked_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "status": "passed",
    "scope": "Actual explicit Git staging of current tracked changes, required untracked review proof files, and the final audit/browser receipts. Every manifest requirement exists in the index. Unrelated untracked files remain untouched. Existing LFS dataset objects are unchanged; no new formal checkpoint or LFS object is staged. This is index membership and selected mutation verification, not a claim of arbitrary dynamic replay coverage.",
    "selected_paths": sorted(selected),
    "staged_changed_paths": sorted(changed),
    "all_required_paths_in_index": len(manifest["required_paths"]),
    "audit_snapshot_map_sha256": hashlib.sha256((AUDIT / "runtime-snapshot-map.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "browser_report_sha256": hashlib.sha256((BROWSER / "report.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "verification_program": Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
proof = ROOT / "docs/validation-artifacts/integration-publication-staging.json"
proof.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
subprocess.run(["git", "add", proof.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()], check=True)
print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "selected": len(selected),
            "staged_changed": len(changed),
            "required_in_index": len(manifest["required_paths"]),
        }
    ),
    flush=True,
)
